Name: Vanilla-Style Yoba Portraits
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I like my characters to all be done in a vanilla style so I've been utilizing Poltergeister & Jazzybee's [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdv-creator-masc]Stardew Valley Character Creator[/url] to give some custom NPCs a makeover! I decided to share the ones that have open permissions or I've been given permission for in case you're OCD like me.

This is a portrait replacement for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14871]Custom NPC - Yoba[/url] by jeremy0709. Permissions were open for this one. Just download, drag and drop over the original mod, and let it overwrite! Enjoy!

*Note: I did test this with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30331]English translation[/url] of the original mod and should work fine with that too :)
